pages.text: The Reactor is the mid-game power source: one unit outperforms a dozen generators but requires heat control.$(br2)$(bold)Construction:$(reset)$(li)Build a hollow sealed box from Reactor Casings (outer edge length 5 or 7)$(li)Place 1 Reactor Core inside$(li)Mount the $(l:akaishi:fuel_system)controller$(/l) and ports (Fuel/Energy Output/Waste) on the walls$(li)Add fuel rods (up to 10) and cooling components (up to 20) inside$(br2)The controller only operates once the structure is formed. Breaking any casing collapses the structure and halts the burn.

$(bold)Operation:$(reset)$(li)Each fuel rod unlocks one fuel slot; more rods allow more fuel cells to be burned at once$(li)Fuel cells are placed in the Fuel Port (27-slot buffer, item-pipe compatible) and fed into the controller automatically$(li)Empty cells are retrieved automatically$(br2)$(bold)Output:$(reset) power flows through the Energy Output Port into the grid; depleted fuel is pumped into the Waste Port's tank.$(br2)For longer and stronger burns, both fuel and cooling must be handled first; see $(l:akaishi:fuel_system)Fuel & Cooling$(/l).

$(bold)Temperature thresholds:$(reset)$(li)Base temperature is 300℃; hotter fuel raises it$(li)400-700℃: the optimal range, full output$(li)850℃: warning; output begins to decrease (operation does not stop)$(li)1000℃: the limit; a 10-second countdown to explosion that creates a large decay zone$(br2)$(bold)Cooling:$(reset) cooling components only work when adjacent to a fuel rod, and heat sinks make them more effective; passive cooling removes only about 20% of heat, so heat sinks provide the majority of cooling.$(br2)Mining blocks at full heat also leaks a decay zone, so an exit plan must always be prepared.

$(bold)Depleted fuel:$(reset) approximately 20% of consumed fuel becomes depleted fuel, which can be recycled rather than discarded.$(br2)The waste tank has a capacity limit; it must be pumped out with fluid pipes or fed into a purification/recycling chain, otherwise the reactor stalls once full and the fuel is consumed without benefit.$(br2)The recycling path is in $(l:akaishi:liquid_fuel)Liquid Fuel Chain$(/l) and $(l:akaishi:plasma)Plasma Chain$(/l).
Reading order: the $(l:akaishi:generator)Energy Generator$(/l) first, then Fuel & Cooling, then the Reactor, and finally the Fusion Reactor once power demands exceed it.
